scope: Independent standard for mhz19b on the fixed uart_polling task configuration, based on its copied reference driver, fixed task requirements, supplied Zephyr API pack and harness. Excludes sample_ref application cadence and device-register behavior.

api_contract.fixed_task_context: uart1 DT device handle with 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit

signatures.uart_poll_out: void uart_poll_out(const struct device *dev, unsigned char out_char)
signatures.uart_poll_in: int uart_poll_in(const struct device *dev, unsigned char *p_char)

handle_and_operations.configuration: UART1, 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit (8N1)

headers: zephyr/kernel.h for timing calls where used
api_contract.return_semantics: uart_poll_in is nonblocking: 0 means a byte was received and nonzero means no byte is available; poll_out returns void. Preserve fallible status from other operations.

facts.requirement: Bind the uart1 device handle selected by DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_NODELABEL(uart1)); line format is handled as a separate fact.

Provide uart_poll_out(const struct device *, unsigned char) for request transmission and uart_poll_in(const struct device *, unsigned char *) for response polling. uart_poll_in is nonblocking: 0 means a byte was received and nonzero means none; no blocking timeout is promised by that API.
Preserve the fallible API status needed to detect or propagate bus/GPIO configuration and transaction failures; do not convert an error return into success.
Use UART line configuration 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit (8N1).
